examples.text: Tengo el triple de dinero que tú.
examples.en: I have three times as much money as you.

examples.text: Él gana el triple que yo.
examples.en: He earns three times more than me.

examples.text: Esta caja es el triple de grande que esa.
examples.en: This box is three times as big as that one.

examples.text: Mi hermana tiene el triple de libros que yo.
examples.en: My sister has three times as many books as I do.

examples.text: Tu casa es el triple de grande que la mía.
examples.en: Your house is three times as large as mine.
